question: I'm a CS senior (P-007) planning my final semester (Spring 2026). Which BA minor courses do I still need, and which of those are offered in Spring 2026?

domain_contributions.programs: P-007's BA minor completed courses: 73-102, 70-311, 70-122, 70-332, 70-341, 70-391. Identify which BA minor requirements remain

wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing only the BA minor requirements (programs domain) cannot tell P-007 which required courses are available this semester. Knowing only the Spring 2026 schedule cannot determine which courses P-007 still needs for the minor.
common_mistake: Listing all BA minor required courses as 'available' without filtering out those P-007 has already completed; or listing completed courses as still needed

Step 2 (programs): Identify remaining BA minor courses for P-007
Step 3 (schedules): Cross-reference remaining courses against Spring 2026 offerings
Conclusion: Several BA courses P-007 hasn't taken are offered Spring 2026; specific requirements need verification against official BA minor checklist
